checkerReadiness: ready to run for uncompressed embedded static meshes
limits: Does not establish visual quality, distinct tree silhouettes, growth, browser lighting, draw calls, transfer of dependent code, resource memory, or real-device performance.
Sparse accessors, extensions, morph targets, skins and animation are inconclusive; validate these with an independent glTF validator and browser evidence before accepting their exports.
Triangle budget applies to the selected exported scene. Supply a tree-only export for near-tree checks; whole clearing and distant-tree profiles have separate limits.
No minimum triangle count: a visually valid simpler export is allowed. Unused meshes are structurally checked but not added to active-scene cost.
This checks mesh structure and relevant binary bounds, not every material, texture, animation or glTF schema rule.
